title: *Nonlimerent // Monosexual: An Aromantic and Asexual History*
summary: A digital collection of materials that appeared in an in-person history and art exhibition in Altona, Victoria, Australia
description: A digital collection of materials that appeared in an in-person history and art exhibition located at the Louis Joel Gallery in Altona, Victoria, Australia, which ran from 1-20 February 2025.
